summary: Split the task into smaller stage-aligned subtasks so a local model can finish one focused step at a time.

subtasks.title: Read the task and the latest evidence.
subtasks.objective: Confirm the goal, scope, stable strings, and the first blocking layer before planning edits.
subtasks.done_when: The task goal, allowed scope, and first blocking layer can be stated in one short paragraph.

subtasks.title: Lock the smallest edit scope.
subtasks.objective: Choose the minimal set of files needed for this round so the model does not expand scope too early.
subtasks.done_when: The files needed for this round are explicit and stable output strings are protected.

subtasks.title: Implement the feature only in allowed files.
subtasks.objective: Apply the smallest code change that satisfies the task goal without widening scope.
subtasks.done_when: Code changes are limited to allowed files and map directly to the task goal.

subtasks.title: Pass local build and automation checks first.
subtasks.objective: Confirm build and local checks are healthy before running the full hardware validation loop.
subtasks.done_when: At least doctor and build are complete, plus test when the task requires it.

subtasks.title: Run task-specific validation commands.
subtasks.objective: Use the task CLI commands or session flow to confirm the user-visible behavior.
subtasks.done_when: Fresh transcript, diagnostic, assertions, or session summary files have been generated.

subtasks.title: Close the loop with evidence only.
subtasks.objective: Use the latest evidence to report pass, fail, or blocked together with the smallest next step.
subtasks.done_when: The conclusion names the result, evidence chain, and one concrete next step.
